items.title: SBA Communications (SBAC) Stock May Be 32% Below Fair Value As Q3 Outlook Improves
items.summary: SBA Communications has bounced recently, yet over a longer stretch its shareholders have seen a sizable pullback, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current US$195.48 share price lines up with the cash the business can generate. items.title: Crown Castle Soars 6% as SpaceX Taps Qualcomm for a “Credible Fourth” Mobile Network
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCrown Castle stock rose 6% today after SpaceX picked Qualcomm to supply base stations for Starlink Mobile’s US 5G network, starting in 2027. Starlink Mobile will need towers, and a fourth carrier could fill the hole DISH left in Crown Castle’s leasing.

items.title: Wireless Data Demand Is Surging. Why Did Crown Castle Cut Its Dividend 32%?
